newsitem.title: CANADA: Saskatchewan regulator approves pork share issue.
newsitem.headline: Saskatchewan regulator approves pork share issue.

text.p: The Saskatchewan Securities Commission on Thursday approved an initial public offering of 12,500 limited partnership shares in Bear Hills Pork Producers Ltd, a Saskatchewan Wheat Pool statement said.

"Bear Hills Pork Producers is the second pork production facility to be granted approval to sell units. The facility has been established in cooperation with farmers, community groups and other interested investors," said John LaClare, chief operating officer of SWP unit Heartland Pork.
Revenues will pay for a 2,400 farrow-to-finish hog barn.
An affiliate of Heartland was expected to provide up to C$3.25 million for the construction project, about a quarter of building costs in northwest Saskatchewan, SWP said.
